f3_program: collection("jace.trip.segment_distances", "distance", "jace.trip", source("If Jace drives for 4 hours straight, take a 30-minute break, and then drives for another 9 hours straight, how many miles will he travel"))
observe(at("jace.driving.rate", "current"), 60, "mile_per_hour", source("Jace drives 60 miles per hour"))
observe(at("jace.trip.first_drive.duration", "current"), 4, "hour", source("drives for 4 hours straight"))
observe(at("jace.trip.break.duration", "current"), 30, "minute", source("take a 30-minute break"))
observe(at("jace.trip.second_drive.duration", "current"), 9, "hour", source("drives for another 9 hours straight"))

rate_relation(at("jace.trip.segment_distances.first_drive", "current"), at("jace.driving.rate", "current"), at("jace.trip.first_drive.duration", "current"), source("Jace drives 60 miles per hour. If Jace drives for 4 hours straight"))

rate_relation(at("jace.trip.segment_distances.second_drive", "current"), at("jace.driving.rate", "current"), at("jace.trip.second_drive.duration", "current"), source("Jace drives 60 miles per hour. If Jace drives for 4 hours straight, take a 30-minute break, and then drives for another 9 hours straight"))
query("sum", "jace.trip.segment_distances", "current")
assumptions: The stated driving rate applies to both driving segments, and the break is not a driving segment.

f3_program: collection("mary_and_friends.blue_marbles_collected", "blue_marble", "mary_and_friends", source("total number of blue marbles collected by the friends together"))
observe(at("mary.friends.count", "current"), 2, "count", source("Mary and her two friends"))

multiple(at("mary_and_friends.red_marbles_collected.mary.count", "monday_to_friday"), at("mary_and_friends.red_marbles_collected.jenny.count", "monday_to_friday"), 2, source("Mary collected twice as many red marbles as Jenny"))

fraction_of(at("mary_and_friends.blue_marbles_collected.mary.count", "monday_to_friday"), at("mary_and_friends.blue_marbles_collected.anie.count", "monday_to_friday"), 1, 2, source("half the number of blue marbles collected by Anie"))

offset(at("mary_and_friends.red_marbles_collected.anie.count", "monday_to_friday"), at("mary_and_friends.red_marbles_collected.mary.count", "monday_to_friday"), 20, "count", source("Anie, who collected 20 more red marbles than Mary"))

multiple(at("mary_and_friends.blue_marbles_collected.anie.count", "monday_to_friday"), at("mary_and_friends.blue_marbles_collected.jenny.count", "monday_to_friday"), 2, source("Anie, who collected 20 more red marbles than Mary and twice the number of blue marbles Jenny collected"))
observe(at("mary_and_friends.red_marbles_collected.jenny.count", "monday_to_friday"), 30, "count", source("Jenny collected 30 red marbles and 25 blue marbles"))
observe(at("mary_and_friends.blue_marbles_collected.jenny.count", "monday_to_friday"), 25, "count", source("Jenny collected 30 red marbles and 25 blue marbles"))
query("sum", "mary_and_friends.blue_marbles_collected", "monday_to_friday")
assumptions: Jenny and Anie are Mary's two friends, and the stated marble counts apply to the Monday-to-Friday collection period.

f3_program: observe(at("company.revenue_by_customer_headquarters.taiwan", "2019"), 2703, "currency", cell("Taiwan", "2019"))
observe(at("company.revenue_by_customer_headquarters.japan", "2019"), 958, "currency", cell("Japan", "2019"))
observe(at("company.revenue.total", "2019"), 23406, "currency", cell("", "2019"))

sum_relation(at("company.revenue_by_customer_headquarters.taiwan_and_japan", "2019"), at("company.revenue_by_customer_headquarters.taiwan", "2019"), at("company.revenue_by_customer_headquarters.japan", "2019"), source("revenue from Taiwan and Japan"))
query("percentage_ratio", at("company.revenue_by_customer_headquarters.taiwan_and_japan", "2019"), at("company.revenue.total", "2019"))
assumptions: The blank-labeled final table row is the total-revenue row.

f3_program: collection("claire.garden.flowers", "flower", "claire.garden", source("Claire has 400 flowers in her garden"))
observe(at("claire.garden.flowers.count", "initial"), 400, "count", source("Claire has 400 flowers in her garden"))
observe(at("claire.garden.flowers.tulips.count", "initial"), 120, "count", source("One hundred twenty are tulips"))

sum_relation(at("claire.garden.flowers.count", "initial"), at("claire.garden.flowers.tulips.count", "initial"), at("claire.garden.flowers.roses.count", "initial"), source("One hundred twenty are tulips, and the rest are roses"))
observe(at("claire.garden.flowers.roses.white.count", "initial"), 80, "count", source("Eighty of the roses are white"))

sum_relation(at("claire.garden.flowers.roses.count", "initial"), at("claire.garden.flowers.roses.white.count", "initial"), at("claire.garden.flowers.roses.red.count", "initial"), source("Eighty of the roses are white, while the rest are red"))
observe(at("claire.garden.flowers.roses.red.unit_value", "sale"), 0.75, "currency_per_rose", source("Each red rose is worth $0.75"))
fraction_of(at("claire.sale.red_roses.count", "sale"), at("claire.garden.flowers.roses.red.count", "initial"), 1, 2, source("sell 1/2 of the total number of red roses"))

product_relation(at("claire.sale.earnings", "sale"), at("claire.sale.red_roses.count", "sale"), at("claire.garden.flowers.roses.red.unit_value", "sale"), source("Each red rose is worth $0.75. How much will Claire earn if she can sell 1/2 of the total number of red roses"))
query("value", at("claire.sale.earnings", "sale"))
observe(at("group.financial_assets_fvpl.additions", "2018"), 60807, "rmb_million", cell("Additions (Note (a))", "2018"))
observe(at("group.financial_assets_fvpl.additions", "2019"), 44618, "rmb_million", cell("Additions (Note (a))", "2019"))
query("difference", at("group.financial_assets_fvpl.additions", "2018"), at("group.financial_assets_fvpl.additions", "2019"))
assumptions: Change is interpreted chronologically from 2018 to 2019.
